Indices are Fin n, blocks are Euclidean Real Fin dim and stacked norm is PiLp2. Valid restricts n>0,lambda>0,eta>0,K>=1,0<m<=M,L>=0. Real parameters are finite. The zero-dimensional block space remains well-defined.

All i,x,v and i,x,y are universally quantified in the intended assumptions. f and oracle are instance/admissibility arguments; raw admissible quantifies every minimizer for its gap-dependent restriction. There is no input to the algorithm carrying a hidden objective.

The predicates define hypotheses, not theorems. Old successful uses an existential minimizer but is not the planned new public success field; it cannot discharge the pending direct accuracy requirement.

The hypotheses split domain restrictions into valid and objective/oracle conditions into admissible. Positivity of m and nonnegativity of L are not lost merely because Assumption1/2 bodies take unrestricted real arguments. Connectivity relaxation is expressly recorded.
Checked each compiled body, including1/(2lambda),1/lambda, factors2 and6, squared/cubed K, and real exponents3/2 and1/2. All match the graph interpretation and its preserved source correction.
The internal allowedAlgorithm pins the reviewed dobocK factory and exact oracle replies; none of the analytic parameters changes its initialization or recurrence.

Exact replies hold for every seed/time/query. The legacy successful clause is a.e. under the given probability measure. That old probability packaging is retained only for compatibility; pointwise accuracy is still required of the new setup.
